facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The sun began to set. The sky turned soft pink. Pip stood on a small hay bale. "Thank you all," he said. "You are my true friends." The friends gathered close. They all hugged together. Everyone celebrated their friendship.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: As the sun began to set over the wide green field, the sky turned soft pink and gold. Pip stood on a small hay bale and looked at his four dear friends, his eyes shining. "Thank you for everything," he said softly, his voice trembling just a bit. "You welcomed me. You made promises with me. You were brave with me. You are my family now." Wooly leaned her head against his shoulder. Daisy stamped her hoof gently, a tear in her brown eye. Gigi honked once with pride, her wings fluttering. Penny gave a happy cluck and nestled close. They all knew that whatever came next — sunshine or storm — they would face it together. Everyone celebrated their friendship, and the farm became home for all of them, now and always.
